findings.claim: The supplied review material must provide complete visibility of the owned implementation paths before the OpenAPI field-fidelity goal can be accepted.
findings.observed: The caller-computed diff visibility contract is complete=false: the owned OpenAPI YAML is only partial and the owned focused contract test is omitted, so those omitted portions were not reviewed.
findings.rationale: The supplied TDD proof establishes a focused RED/GREEN cycle, but it cannot replace semantic inspection of omitted implementation material. The caller explicitly requires incomplete evidence/visibility to finalize without ACCEPT and forbids inferring absence or correctness from omitted paths.
findings.required: Provide a complete caller-supplied diff or equivalent review material covering the full owned OpenAPI YAML and focused contract test, then perform a new acceptance run.
